data.message: I propose a 10-ton catch per fisher this month and whenever stock is 500. With 25 fishers, total catch is 250, leaving 250; either replenishment outcome restores 500. That yields each of us $10,000 per month indefinitely if we all follow it. I intend to request 10 under this plan. Please state whether you support it; we can review revealed catches before next month's discussion.
